name: Theresia van Astrea
japaneseName: テレシア・ヴァン・アストレア
description: Theresia van Astrea was the previous generation's Sword Saint, the beloved wife of Wilhelm van Astrea, mother of Heinkel, and grandmother of Reinhard. A gentle girl who cherished flowers and hated fighting, she shouldered the blade to end the Demi-Human War forty years ago. Slain during the Great Subjugation against the White Whale, her resurrected corpse was wielded as a puppet by the Witch Cult in Arc 5 before finally finding peace.
